WITH sma_10004_cte AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', month_start) AS metric_time__month
    , CASE WHEN valid_order_count >= 1 THEN member_id END AS __monthly_paid_buyer_count
    , valid_order_count AS __monthly_paid_order_count
    , net_sales_cents AS __monthly_paid_sales_cents
    , CASE WHEN valid_order_count >= 2 THEN member_id END AS __monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count
  FROM "data"."main"."monthly_paid_account" monthly_paid_semantic_src_10000
)

SELECT
  MAX(subq_10.monthly_paid_buyer_count) AS monthly_paid_buyer_count
  , MAX(subq_10.monthly_paid_order_count) AS monthly_paid_order_count
  , MAX(subq_10.monthly_paid_sales_cents) AS monthly_paid_sales_cents
  , MAX(subq_10.monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count) AS monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count
  , MAX(subq_17.monthly_paid_repeat_rate) AS monthly_paid_repeat_rate
  , MAX(subq_17.monthly_paid_avg_order_value) AS monthly_paid_avg_order_value
FROM (
  SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT __monthly_paid_buyer_count) AS monthly_paid_buyer_count
    , SUM(__monthly_paid_order_count) AS monthly_paid_order_count
    , SUM(__monthly_paid_sales_cents) AS monthly_paid_sales_cents
    , COUNT(DISTINCT __monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count) AS monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count
  FROM sma_10004_cte
  WHERE metric_time__month BETWEEN '2024-09-01' AND '2024-09-30'
) subq_10
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT
    CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT __monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT __monthly_paid_buyer_count), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS monthly_paid_repeat_rate
    , CAST(SUM(__monthly_paid_sales_cents) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(SUM(__monthly_paid_order_count), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS monthly_paid_avg_order_value
  FROM sma_10004_cte
  WHERE metric_time__month BETWEEN '2024-09-01' AND '2024-09-30'
) subq_17
